title: Justin Herbert Says Girlfriend Madison Beer ‘Changed My Life Forever’ in Sweet Birthday Post
summary: The football player added that the singer is his "favorite person of all time."
contentText:
Madison Beer has a sweet new message from her boyfriend, Los Angeles Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert, to keep in her locket.

On Thursday, the football player shared an adorable black-and-white photo of himself and his girlfriend — who just turned 27 — embracing on the sidelines, writing on his Instagram Story, “Happy birthday to my favorite person of all time.”

“I love you so much,” he continued. “You’ve changed my life forever.”

Herbert went on to share another snap of himself and Beer cozied up together and gushed, “I am the luckiest guy alive.”

Also on her birthday, the New York native shared photos of herself posing with an “It’s My Birthday” badge, earning comments from friends such as Hailey Bieber — who wrote, “Birthday angel” — and, of course, Herbert. “My love,” he wrote in the replies.

The singer and athlete have been dating since sometime before August, when they were first spotted together. Since then, they’ve sat courtside at an L.A. Lakers game and attended the World Series together, and Beer has supported Herbert at many of his games.

Beer is fresh off of the January release of Locket , her third studio album. The project debuted at No. 10 on the Billboard 200 , marking what is easily her highest peak on the chart to date; her past two albums, 2021’s Life Support and 2023’s Grammy-nominated Silence Between Songs reached Nos. 65 and 86, respectively.

Locket also helped Beer make her debut on the Billboard Hot 100 , with single “Bittersweet” entering the chart in mid-January and peaking at No. 68 a couple of weeks later.
